get.description: Fixed route classes retain no request identities. Process-handler counters reset on restart; startedAt identifies the first observed request. Histograms use disjoint latency buckets. Written bytes are successfully accepted by ResponseWriter; decodedJSONBytes excludes 304/no-body responses. Handler completion includes failures, cancellation and aborted streams. HTTP status alone does not prove complete delivery. Concurrent counter snapshots are approximate and exclude the collecting request from terminal totals. filesystem reports caller-available space on the data root filesystem, independently of content quota; unknown readings are null. Write stall events and active weighted nanoseconds use Pebble callbacks and reset when the store opens. Fixed selection/history query totals count budget units, primary result records/data examined, matches and failures, including partial failed work; they do not count all disk I/O. Result/cohort cache counters expose hits, misses, rejected inserts, evictions and accounted retention, not process RSS.

get.summary: Frozen progress from published completed jobs
get.description: Frozen scope from published completed attempts. Without original locked plan content, plannedJobs and collectionComplete remain null. With verified content, plannedJobs is the machine/corpus Cartesian scope and collectionComplete means each pair has at least one published completed attempt, including failed or unsupported outcomes. publishedJobs counts attempts; publishedCorpusJobs counts distinct machine/corpus pairs. Staged imports never contribute.

get.summary: Change over exact matched workload contracts at two frozen selections
get.description: Both JSON CohortScope parameters require explicit revisions and one identical runtime track, environment, metric/method selectors and population policy. Recompute weighting over only exact matching available cells. Report unmatched and reused cells; no paired uncertainty is inferred. No evidence or membership arrays are embedded.

get.summary: Selected completed-job history interpretation
get.description: Optional publisher-declared history bindings reference exact exported report/configuration records, with source/target dates and explicit release association separate from measurement collection and publication. Interpretation is a trusted publisher assertion, not independent source verification. collectedAt comes from source report created, can be null, and is not a per-pass observation time. Does not create independent observations or fetch evidence. Empty bindings do not imply unsupported history.

200.description: Bounded immutable history interpretation bindings for a published job

get.summary: Bounded exact historical series of original summaries
get.description: Requires one exact revision/environment/track/contract/definition/method plus scenario/profile/statistic and an explicit collection-time window. Source-report-created is the recorded time axis. Reduction keeps original first/last and exact numeric extrema in ordered-observation buckets; all nonnumeric records and neighbors are mandatory. No point, interval or absent-period observation is invented. Gap-heavy or oversized scopes return 422; the existing paginated history endpoint supplies raw access using the same scope. Both dataset and display policy are pinned for immutable caching.

200.description: Original bounded plotted summaries and explicit display policy
